svg.title: End of set. In thrust we trust. Reliability is a feature. So is honesty about what isn't done yet. A launch, drawn as an engagement: a countdown, then liftoff at the first client call, max-Q at scope and sign-off, staging at the build, fairing separation at the release, and orbit with the runbook after. Last updated 2026-11-14.

g.text: Reliability is a feature. So is honesty
